title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Rowdy Rajkumar
desc: A small-time farmer, decides to steal and loots money from corrupt government officials in order to develop his remote village.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.

title: The Real Tiger
desc: An undercover cop, who is also the son of an MLA, strives to apprehend a dangerous don who is involved in illicit activities.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.
